bug_semantics: A tenant able to create or update Fission Function or Environment CRDs could request SYS_TIME in securityContext.capabilities.add on a tenant-controlled container or init container. The v1.24.0 admission validator and executor merge sanitizer used a fixed denylist containing only SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE, SYS_MODULE, DAC_READ_SEARCH, and DAC_OVERRIDE, so SYS_TIME passed both layers and reached the resulting pod. Without restrictive Pod Security Admission on the function-pod namespace, CAP_SYS_TIME permits clock_settime(CLOCK_REALTIME) against the node-wide, non-time-namespaced real-time clock, corrupting wall-clock-dependent state for co-tenants. The separate OCI-default-capability concern was not fully addressed by this advisory's fix.
flaw_origin: This is an incomplete security remediation. PR #3391 member 2db76f65dbfe4f657b4a4efb506ed63b24623e92 first created dangerousCapabilities as a six-entry denylist and rejected only map hits, deliberately allowing every omitted capability. Later PR member c8a58b7a88448f55bdf3ff01e149e82370fcfd7d copied the same incomplete policy into the merge sanitizer. The mainline commit e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64 is the squash aggregate of the four-member PR chain and is therefore not substituted for the smallest real BIC. The direct parent already had the broader unconstrained merge behavior, but it did not contain this advisory's newly written incomplete-denylist mechanism.

reasoning: The reviewer wins the introducer_sha disagreement. Under the protocol, the BIC is the smallest real commit that first wrote the vulnerable lines, and a decomposable squash aggregate must be rejected. First-party commit objects prove that 2db76f65dbfe4f657b4a4efb506ed63b24623e92, not landing squash e484df8460bb4e8026e24210120602aa7f181f64, first wrote the authoritative six-entry admission denylist and its permissive complement; c8a58b7a88448f55bdf3ff01e149e82370fcfd7d later duplicated that policy in defense in depth rather than originating it. The direct parent lacks the validator and denylist, although its broader passthrough was already unsafe, so parent absence is true for this incomplete-remediation mechanism. For fix_sha, both prior audits were correct that the published, released landing fix is 2569b42bfadbcb7d78b55a00a60f77937e522699. The reviewer wins the associated direct-fix disagreement because 943121151156b777a73bda8a7dee0a6bdd6efd8a is the smallest PR member that first changed both enforcement layers to positive allowlists; the landing squash remains fix_sha because it is the commit referenced by the advisory and shipped in v1.25.0. The allowlists close explicit CAP_SYS_TIME injection even though the later PR member intentionally rolls back forced drop-ALL. Because the smallest BIC commit object itself contains the explicit Claude co-author trailer and that same BIC creates the causally incomplete policy, the gate-complete verdict is AI_ROOT_CAUSE.
